checks: Preserved blocked-vessel infarction versus ruptured-vessel brain hemorrhage and impact by damage site/extent, no capability fixed by disease name. Angina temporary insufficient myocardial flow versus infarction injury/necrosis, no pain-degree diagnosis; hypertension/diabetes/coronary background and healthcare-professional-confirmed diagnosis/treatment.

Preserved heart failure reduced output and possible breathlessness/palpitations/fatigue/edema/weight/urine changes without one-sign diagnosis. Acute paralysis/speech abnormality/breathlessness/severe chest pain prompt emergency aid/reporting before cause confirmation.

Preserved no forced forward-leaning posture, tolerable position only per healthcare instruction/individual plan and no inferred recovery from posture. Salt/fluid/activity management follows assessed plan; no unilateral fluid reduction/continued exercise from disease label; acute first response distinct from long-term management.
Preserved actual observation time/person’s words/usual difference/actions to explicit healthcare professional and nurse art recipient, no diagnostic/treatment-change authorization.

Preserved pneumonia microbial inflammation/possibly atypical elderly symptoms; dysphagia versus aspiration versus aspiration pneumonia, saliva/bacteria route and cough-free aspiration. Oral hygiene/posture/food form reduce risk but no complete prevention guarantee.

Preserved explicit nurse and speech/hearing therapist recipient for swallowing state/assessment. No lying down immediately after meal remains personal-condition/plan-based; stop feeding help for abnormal breathlessness/choking/voice/expression and seek aid/report under institution method, no independent drinking/posture/food-form changes, swallowing tests/drugs/emergency techniques.

Preserved type1immune-related beta-cell loss/insulin deficiency, young-age tendency but any-age onset; type2reduced insulin effectiveness plus inadequate secretion, multifactorial without blaming overeating. High-glucose signs may be few, actual observation/measurement/treatment within plan and duties; no age-based type diagnosis or unilateral food/activity/drug decisions.

Preserved retinal/renal/peripheral-nerve complications separately, reduced sensation and delayed wound healing, painless does not mean no wound or normal nerve. Wound location/appearance/person’s sensation/time reported per plan, no omitted record or hidden course from independent ointment; treatment-plan food/activity/drugs and person’s satisfaction/wishes with responsible person.

Preserved visual acuity versus field, central scotoma/peripheral visibility and narrowed field; enlargement does not restore field. Hemispatial neglect is attention/brain-related and distinct from hemifield loss, may coexist; source observed tray-side omission not sufficient cause/support diagnosis.

Preserved person’s view/awareness, evaluation and wishes for object placement/light/text/explanation, no unauthorised rearrangement that removes cues; black diagram portion not personal actual field or staff diagnosis.

Preserved pacemaker personal device instructions/no hard impact/no blanket activity ban or setting change. Hemodialysis external blood path, removal of some waste/excess water and vascular-access protection; arm load/bathing/salt/fluid instructions from treatment team, no universal dialysis-day bath ban or common fluid restriction; bleeding/swelling promptly reported.

Preserved oxygen cylinder/concentrator versus ventilation-support ventilator distinction, oxygen supports combustion and fire/severe burn risk, prescribed flow/device settings not changed. Infection/fire/power/supply-interruption planning and backup needs depend on actual device and facility/home plan.

Preserved stool/urine abdominal stoma differences, not every bladder impairment has stoma; trained plan-based appliance/excreta handling and red/eroded/leaking/unusual state reporting, no inexperienced self-directed appliance/opening adjustment or text-only device procedures.

Preserved intellectual disability developmental cognitive/adaptive difficulty versus mental illness, adult dignity, life history/stage/wishes/choice and capabilities. Schizophrenia/mood disorders differ, acute symptom judgment difficulty does not mean always incapable/dangerous; individual present state/plan.

Preserved depressive state versus mania, one quiet/talkative/happy encounter not diagnosis; usual difference/time/person’s difficulty. Hallucination without matching external stimulus, delusion held despite mismatch and auditory hallucination as subtype; specialist evaluation, validate fear/distress separately from affirming content as fact; calm listening rather than arguing/dismissing and emergency institution aid if safety threatened.
